_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 68 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 166,900 berths as of December 31, 2024'; 'We compete with a number of cruise lines as well as land-based vacation alternatives for consumers’ leisure time'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2024 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 68 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 166,900 berths as of December 31, 2024'; 'We compete with a number of cruise lines as well as land-based vacation alternatives for consumers’ leisure time'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2024 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +95% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.06; conservative 2yr -30%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY15-FY24 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.6%/yr (Q3 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.4%/yr (FY15-FY24 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY24 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2025-08-08) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (43.6% downside to Bear $170 / +-6.1% upside to Bull $283) | Adj composite 2.69 vs market 3.75: gap -1.06 [OVERVALUED] | +95% above the EPP floor $155 (10x FY25E $15.48) | Conservative 2-yr case: -30.3% total (-15.2%/yr) | At 19.5x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $399 sits above the BULL case; Net Yields +5.3% in Q2 2025, forward net revenue +4.96-5.47% (Q3 2025 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
